name: What are common signs of a gas line leak?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs of a gas line leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Recognizing the signs of a gas leak is crucial for safety. Common indicators include a distinctive rotten egg smell, which is added to natural gas for detection. You might also hear a hissing or whistling sound near a gas line, feel dizzy, or experience headaches. If you notice dead or discolored vegetation near an outdoor gas line, this could also signal a leak. Never ignore these signs, as gas leaks pose serious health and safety risks.
acceptedAnswer.description: A rotten egg smell, hissing sounds, dizziness, or dead vegetation near gas lines are common signs of a leak.
